strings.mdKbSmart: • Su'e le pusa ki'i atamai: siaki le pusa ki'i o lo'o i ai nei i le lisi fa'aleaogaina o le Google (CRL) ma fa'ata'ita'i le tele o fa'apogai se'ia maua se pusa ki'i aoga, fa'atasi ai ma se fa'amaumauga otometi ma toe amata auaunaga Google. E tamo'e i paipa uma ma mana'omia le initaneti (1-3 minute).
strings.mdKbNet: • Pusa ki mai feso'ota'iga: la'u mai se pusa ki mai le faleteuoloa aloa'ia (GitHub) ma teu i le /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Mana'omia le initaneti ma e 1-3 minute e alu ai. Fa'aaoga pe a le manuia le su'ega atamai po'o le suiga ma le lima le pusa ki.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP su'esu'ega: siaki vaega o lo'o maua Remote Key Provisioning, su'esu'e le TEE fa'amaonia tusi fa'amaonia, ma fa'aali le tulaga meafaigaluega KmInstallKeybox. E leai se suiga - o se vaaiga manino tulaga o masini.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine siaki (faitau-na'o): fa'aalia Widevine fa'ailoga tulaga (L1/L3) mai dumpsys, DRM (IDM) fa'aulu faila faila, ma mea fa'aoga fa'aogaina. E leai se mea e suia.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Fa'atonuga RKP: fa'agasolo le tusi sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh. Fa'atonu mataupu fa'amaonia pe a le manuia le pasi otometi. O ta'aloga uma e lolomi ai se laina manuia/to'ilalo.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Fa'atonu atoatoa RKP: fa'agasolo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh atoa. Taulima mataupu faigata ma umi se taimi. O se taunuuga manino e aliali mai i le faaiuga.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Toe setiina GMS: fa'amama le Play Store ma le Google auaunaga (GMS+GSF) fa'amaumauga ma toe fa'a otometi le masini. Mo na'o le fa'amaonia ma'a'a - e le pa'i lava i au ata po'o faila.
strings.mdCertify: • Ta'alo tusipasi: siaki le RKP fa'amaonia tulaga o le masini ma toe fa'afo'i meatotino fa'amaonia pe a mana'omia. E le pa'i i fa'amatalaga a tagata fa'aoga.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER toe faaleleia: toe faaleleia Google au'aunaga (SOTER) mataupu e feso'ota'i ma fa'amaoniga o masini. Fa'aoga mo nisi masini e fa'alagolago i le SOTER nai lo le Ta'alo Fa'amaoni.
strings.mdPifApply: • Fa'aaoga le PIF: fa'agasolo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh malosi. Fa'aoga le tamatamai lima ua filifilia (fa'alotoifale/agaitia) ma fa'afou le pif.prop/pif.json faila. O se taunuuga manino e aliali mai i totonu o le ogalaau.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF siaki: fa'aalia le tulaga o le afi fa'apipi'i, faila fa'ailoga tamatamailima (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ma ogalaau. Siaki na'o - e leai se mea e suia.
strings.mdCanary: • Fa'afouga Canary: fa'agasolo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Aumai le Canary Engine fa'amalolo lata mai ina ia mautinoa le fetaui ma le fa'atulafonoina RKP tusipasi (Fepuari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Su'esu'ega afi: siaki le tulaga TrickyStoreOSS (pid, ogalaau), faila pusa autu (active vs user), le mea moni vs spoofed masini fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP ki. Fa'aaliga fa'ama'i.
strings.hintKbSlots: E pulea e le module avanoa pusa autu e lua: o le mea muamua (pa'ia, e le soloia) ma le lona lua (tua). O lenei fa'ailoga e fa'aalia ai po'o fea le avanoa o lo'o galue, fesuia'i le mana'o, pe fa'alauiloa le tulaga lua i le tulaga muamua i luga o se talosaga manino - fa'atasi ai ma fa'amaumauga ma se fa'amaumauga atoa.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Su'esu'ega Fa'amaoni: siaki le fa'aulufale mai o le ki TEE, le tui o le faletusi i totonu o le keystore2, le tulaga fa'aleaogaina (CRL), le lisi o puipuiga ma le setete RKP. Faitau-na'o - e leai se suiga.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Avanoa Pusa Kisi: fa'aalia le tulaga o avanoa muamua ma avanoa lua ma fesuia'i le mea e fiafia i ai. Le mea muamua (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) e puipuia i taimi uma ma e le soloia. O le fa'alauiloaina o le tulaga lua i le tulaga muamua e mana'omia ai se fa'amaoniga manino.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Si'itia le avanoa lona lua i le tulaga muamua:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml avea ma mea autu o le slot.
• O le tulaga muamua o lo'o i ai nei ua sefe e fai ma fa'amaumauga a'o le'i toe sui.
• E leai se mea e tapeina — o le ta'aloga e toe fa'afo'i.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Fa'amama le avanoa lona lua:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml o le a aveese.
• E le pa'i le avanoa muamua.

Faaauau?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Su'e le pusa ki'i atamai (fou i le v3.17):

• Siaki le pusa ki'i o lo'o iai nei i le Google lisi fa'alēaogāina (CRL).
• Fa'ata'ita'i le tele o fa'apogai se'ia maua se pusa ki'i mama.
• Fa'apolopolo otometi + toe amata Google#00009# Google Google Google Google Google Google Google Google Google Google (1-3 minu). Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Aumai le pusa ki mai le initaneti:

• Si'itia le pusa kisi aloa'ia ma fa'amaonia.
• Fa'apipi'i tumau (e le'i toe fa'afo'i i tua).

⚠️ Mana'omia le initaneti (e o'o i le 1 min). Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Toe tu'u atu RKP ki:

• Leai se fa'amaumauga po'o faila pusa autu e tapeina.
• Toe fa'afou le telefoni pe a uma.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Toe fa'aleleia atoatoa:

• Toe tu'uaiga RKP + toe amata Google auaunaga.
• E otometi lava ona toe fa'afou le masini (e leai se mea e soloia).

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Toe amata Google auaunaga:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — toe amata.
• E leai se mea e soloia ma e LE'I saini i fafo.
• E otometi lava ona toe fa'afouina le masini.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Fa'amalosi le toe tu'uina atu (Mula Fa'amaneta):

• Mo masini e le amana'ia le pusa kisi liki.
• E galue tusa lava pe lelei le ki.
• Leai se fa'amaumauga e tape.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmCertify:
Fa'amalosi Play Store fa'amaonia:

• Fa'amama na'o le fa'aoga o le Faleoloa — e le'i pa'i lau tala.
• Toe fa'afou, ona tatala lea o le Faleoloa.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER lipea:

• Toe amata le auaunaga vendor.soter.
• Fa'amama le SOTER na'o fa'amaumauga.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Fa'aaoga le fa'ailoga tamatamailima (PIF):

• Suia custom.pif.prop ma fa'apipi'i i totonu o le ala afi.
• Mana'omia le toe fa'afou mulimuli ane.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirmCanary:
Fa'afou Canary fingerprint:

• La'uina mai le ata fou o Canary fingerprint mai le Google.
• Fa'asa'o le fa'amaufa'ailoga puipui + toe amata le Google tautua (leai se solo).

⚠️ Mana'omia le initaneti (1-3 min). Fa'aauau?
